Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the task using only IMDb’s Release Info (which listed 2011 DVD/TV dates) without resolving conflicting evidence that Farber’s Nerve was a 2006 film (as indicated by IMDb’s title page and Wikipedia). This failure to cross-verify and synthesize the earliest release date led to the incorrect conclusion that Ekam (2010) was released first, instead of Farber’s Nerve (2006).
